title: Cherit
summary: Cherit is a unique Titan known to Seekers. By some unknown accident or genius operation, his essence became separated from his Amulet thousands of years ago. Unlike his other Titan cousins, Cherit is always invoked and somehow manages to stay anchored to our reality despite the separation from his Amulet. Another result of this separation is Cherit's ability to communicate in human language. He is the only Titan in recorded history to do so, aside from Madea, as Titans communicate with their human counterparts through telepathic impression. He is a friendly and endearing little fellow and best friend to Lok Lambert, whom he loyally accompanies, providing both wisdom and companionship.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Cherit was once a Titan of Lord Casterwill, the first Seeker, and was called to assist in a confrontation against an ominous figure. [Memory Lane] The two considered each other to be good friends. [Knight of the Willblade] At some point, however, Cherit's Amulet was lost, causing him to be constantly anchored to Earth for over 60,000 years. [Huntik Magazine] Cherit has since revealed that he can no longer recall what his Amulet looks like. [Den vs Harrison]

During his interactions with humanity, with whom he was quite interested, Cherit noticed that non-Seekers could not communicate with the bond. He, thus, undertook to communicate through speech, though doing so initially proved to be difficult. [The Treasures of the Argonauts]

Cherit eventually met and befriended Eathon Lambert and moved into Huntik Foundation HQ. [S2E27] He would occasionally accompany Eathon on some of his missions against the Organization, once battling the Professor. [Huntik.com] [TCG:OAL-072] Through Eathon, Cherit made the acquaintance of Dante Vale and lived with him following the disappearance of Eathon. [S1E01]

Through Dante, Cherit also met and befriended Lok Lambert, Eathon's son, who had just entered into the world of Seekers and Titans with whom he formed a very strong friendship along their numerous adventures together. [A Seeker Is Born] Cherit then adventured alongside the team of Lok Lambert, Sophie Casterwill, Dante Vale, and Zhalia Moon, protecting the world from the evil Organization.

Cherit dreamed of Casterwill summoning a large, darkened figure, calling out his name. [Memory Lane]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.wikitext:
[[File:Cherit (Burger Staff).jpg|thumb|Cherit working as kitchen staff at a burger joint]]
Cherit is a deeply loyal, cheerful, and talkative Titan whose vibrant personality stands out among his kin due to his unique ability to speak the human language. Having wandered Earth for centuries having lost his [[Amulet]], Cherit has developed a remarkably human-like temperament, combining a quirky sense of humour with a strong fondness for modern comforts like good food and soft beds.{{Source|S1E04}} {{source|Back Home}} Despite his small size and playful demeanour, Cherit possesses a vast amount of ancient wisdom. He frequently steps into a mentorship role for younger [[Seekers]], such as [[Lok Lambert]], [[Sophie Casterwill]] and [[Den Fears]], using his extensive knowledge of the [[Titans]] and history to help decipher ancient mysteries and offer crucial guidance when the team faces unfamiliar threats. 
[[File:S1E22 Cherit eating.png|thumb|Cherit enjoying [[Otto|Otto's]] cooking]]
While his lighthearted nature and childlike curiosity make him a fun companion, Cherit is also fiercely brave and selfless in the face of danger. Cherit generally avoids direct physical combat due to his limited offensive power, but his loyalty to the Seekers is absolute. When his friends are in peril, he does not hesitate to fly directly into harm's way, using his unique energy-boosting abilities to empower his allies at great personal risk to himself. This perfect balance of ancient intelligence, comical charm, and fierce protectiveness makes him both the emotional heart and a vital strategic asset to the team.

sections.heading: Lok Lambert
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E41 Lok Cherit.png|thumb|Cherit and Lok]]
Cherit is Lok's best friend and loyal companion who is always by his side. Cherit will normally sit on Lok's shoulder during their adventures, acting as his personal little helper and right-hand man. He is always the first to cheer for Lok's successes and encourage him when he is unsure. When the pair first met, Cherit quickly recognised [[Eathon Lambert]]'s strength in him, and showed absolute belief in his potential. {{Source|S1E02}} They quickly developed a close friendship, frequently enjoying the same youthful habits, sharing a mutual love for snacks, games, and casual banter that breaks the tension of their dangerous missions. {{Source|S1E05}}{{Source|S1E20}} Cherit's role as a mentor and support played a huge role in Lok's journey to becoming a powerful [[Seeker]].

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.text:
Cherit is capable of flight using his bat-like wings and has displayed the ability to fire energy blast from his mouth, powerful enough to destroy most other Titans with a single blast, although it leaves him exhausted afterward. [The Casterwill Client] After training with the Huntik foundation since the fall of the Professor, however, Cherit can fire a blast and still be flying; at one point, he fired twice and was still okay. [Knight of the Willblade] Still, despite this, he does show some signs of exhaustion after a blast. [Chasing Void] Cherit has the ability to give other members of his team a power boost through a similar energy blast, which Lok nicknamed 'Energy Charge'. [S1E16] He also has the ability to perfectly mimic peoples' voices. [Absent Heroes]

Due to having been invoked for thousands of years, Cherit can speak and decipher many ancient languages, such as when he translated ancient Egyptian so as to aid Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill in a puzzle. [The Sceptre Deception] Another case was when he translated ancient French to describe the personality of the Casterwill seer, Nostradamus, whom Cherit described as being friendly. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Cherit is also an extremely good chess player. He has hinted that he has been around at least since the invention of chess with some indication that he was involved in its invention. [The Legendary Titan of Fate] He also has some skill at playing the pipe. [The Power of Umbra]

sections.heading: Trivia
sections.wikitext:
* In episode 04 - "[[Into the River of Secrets]]," Cherit notes upon entering the [[Cave of the Gargoyle]] that there may be a family resemblance between himself and the gargoyle statue, hinting that he may be related to [[Gar-Ghoul]] Titans.

* Cherit is closely related to the mischievous [[Impet]] Titans.

* Cherit doesn't need to eat, sleep, or breathe. In episode 44 - "[[The Dead Magic Island]]," Cherit mentions not needing to breathe after being trapped under a log.

* Cherit refers to other Titans collectively as his brothers, sisters, and cousins.

* Story supervisor Maurizio de Angelis has stated that Cherit is the character he most idenfitifed with. {{Extsource|1=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=AjYWmvnOqQo&list=PL6NZlSvyFyQU-o6alH6pXfEqPNXEBFSQo|2=YouTube}}
